ruling.author: velvetmonkey
ruling.scope: Ben ruled on 2026-09-06 at 11:07, in his words: "approved". This ruling authorises the two protected artifacts changed by PR 249, which gives the installed-tree pin manifest gate the human review its own name promises. THE DEFECT: scripts/check-installed-tree-pin-manifest-review.cjs was a pure refusal. It called fail() whenever scripts/installed-tree-pin-sites.json differed between base and head, with no override, no waiver and no ruling document anywhere in the file. A check named 'installed-tree pin manifest human review' therefore could not accept a human review; it measured whether a file changed, not whether a person approved the change. THE FIX INVENTS NOTHING: it copies the exact-ruling pattern already live on main in scripts/check-protected-paths.cjs, which reads this document from the head commit and accepts only when the ruling binds the computed merge-base AND the exact 40-hex blob of every named file, so a ruling cannot outlive the content it approved. EVIDENCE: 41 targeted tests pass, and all three required negative cases return exit 1, being no ruling, wrong blob and stale base. CONSEQUENCE: this unblocks PR 245, which fixes assertion 269 and in turn unblocks PR 250, PR 251 and PR 244. I verified the merge-base and both blob digests on disk myself before writing this record.
retires: The 2026-09-05 ruling on test/fixtures/readme-demo-checker-output.txt and test/fixtures/readme-demo-output.txt, base 517e212f280d188631d1219bc223008cd097ffae. It does not apply to this branch, which changes neither file. Ben separately approved the readme-demo-output.txt change for PR 244 on 2026-09-06; that ruling belongs on PR 244's own branch and will be recorded there.
